findings.text_span: delivery throughput, delivery stability, batch size, review, stability, agent-authored PR, acceptance rate, merge
findings.reason: Some terms are useful, but the density shifts the tone from Korean tech blog to research briefing.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate where possible or move some terms to bibliography.

findings.text_span: CircleCI + DORA + HBR + PR 연구 + LLVM + GitHub
findings.reason: Too many external anchors compete with the author's lived PR-review scene.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep CircleCI and HBR in the main body; keep LLVM/GitHub if responsibility boundary needs external support. Move DORA or PR study to references unless it is central.

findings.reason: Invisible NBSP characters remain after several citation sentences. This is a common generated-document artifact.

findings.suggested_fix: Merge a few adjacent short paragraphs in the opening and conclusion.

findings.reason: Some caution is appropriate, but repeated softeners dilute the main thesis.
